candidates.title: The Picnic Cakes That Tasted of Salt
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered every cake baked for the picnic tasted salty despite following the recipe before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they added extra honey but the next cake tasted even worse; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized two identical unmarked tins held salt and sugar on the same shelf; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they tested and labeled the ingredients before making a fresh small batch, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Books Returned Before They Were Borrowed
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the library kiosk printed return times earlier than the books' checkout times before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced the printer ribbon but every receipt showed the same contradiction; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the kiosk used a different time zone from the library's checkout register; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they synchronized both systems and corrected the affected borrowing records, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Costume Contest With Too Many Votes
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the judges counted more costume-contest votes than there were visitors before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they recounted each colored bead but the total remained too high; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a second ballot box had collected practice ballots along with the live votes; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they separated the practice ballots using the entry record and counted votes transparently, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
